answer: At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a quill tag. The willow cap is checked at intake and whisper publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
